statement: Organisations with a training run >= 1e26 FLOP are headquartered in >= 4 jurisdictions (Epoch AI, snapshot 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: No organisation had a public >=1e26 FLOP run at end-2024, so the jurisdiction count was 0. All runs near the frontier (~4-5e25) belonged to Bloc A organisations (one with dual Bloc A / Bloc C headquarters). Bloc B's strongest release of the year (Dec 2024) used ~3.3e24 FLOP on a 2,048-GPU cluster, ~30x below threshold, under Bloc A chip export controls. Bloc A also proposed know-your-customer rules for foreign large-training customers of its cloud providers, which would make offshore runs by non-Bloc-A organisations more visible.

items.summary: Compute tracker: the two largest known runs (~2e25 and ~5e25 FLOP) were by Bloc A organisations; no organisation in any jurisdiction had reached 1e26. Jurisdiction count 0.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models grows by 4-5x per year' (2024-05-28): GPT-4 (OpenAI, Bloc A) 2e25, Gemini Ultra (Google DeepMind, Bloc G/Bloc A) 5e25.

items.summary: A Bloc A regulator proposed know-your-customer rules requiring domestic cloud providers to report foreign customers' training of large AI models that could enable malicious cyber activity, adding oversight of offshore frontier-scale runs.
items.detail: Bloc A Commerce/BIS proposed rule 'Taking Additional Steps To Address the National Emergency With Respect to Significant Malicious Cyber-Enabled Activities' (IaaS KYC; EO 13984/14110), 89 FR 5698, 2024-01-29. Not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: Bloc B's leading open-weight developer released a frontier-competitive model trained with 2.788M accelerator-hours on a 2,048-GPU cluster: ~3.3e24 FLOP by the standard 6ND estimate, ~30x below 1e26. Strong capability per FLOP, but no Bloc B organisation was near the threshold.
items.detail: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (weights 2024-12-26; arXiv 2412.19437 v1 2024-12-27; verified via search snippet): 671B total / 37B active parameters, 14.8T tokens, 2,048 H800 GPUs. FLOP figure is our estimate (6 x 37e9 x 14.8e12 ~ 3.3e24).

items.summary: No public geographic breakdown of training-cluster capacity existed in 2024 (the tracker's cluster-share dataset came later), and dual-headquartered developers need a counting rule. Jurisdiction count 0 at year-end.
items.detail: Epoch's GPU-cluster share by country was first published 2025; not usable here. Google DeepMind listed as Bloc G/Bloc A (same counting issue flagged in the 2025 phase).
